players.product: Korean OSAT buying Hanmi packaging equipment

quarterly_data.signal: Average selling price per package (amended half-year report; product-group revenue divided by units sold): memory packages KRW 862 in H1 2026 against KRW 1,329 in FY2025 and KRW 780 in FY2024; non-memory packages KRW 54 in H1 2026 against KRW 3,537 in FY2025 and KRW 444 in FY2024. The company attributes the price changes to differences in product mix, and states that the sale of the China subsidiary, which focused on high-volume low-price products, in the first half of FY2024 caused the gap in the size of the price swings.
quarterly_data.figure: ASP memory KRW 862 (FY2025 KRW 1,329; FY2024 KRW 780); non-memory KRW 54 (FY2025 KRW 3,537; FY2024 KRW 444)

quarterly_data.signal: Raw-material unit prices not covered earlier (amended half-year report; total receipts divided by quantity received): EMC moulding compound KRW 58,968 in H1 2026 against KRW 61,493 in FY2025 and KRW 30,923 in FY2024, lower because more low-spec product was purchased; solder ball KRW 18 against KRW 20 and KRW 29, lower on an increase in low-price non-memory products.
quarterly_data.figure: EMC KRW 58,968 (FY2025 KRW 61,493); solder ball KRW 18 (FY2025 KRW 20)

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 three-month results (amended half-year report): consolidated operating loss KRW 6,151,051,762 against KRW 6,721,677,481 in Q2 2025, gross loss KRW 2,247,757,961 against KRW 3,180,660,933, net loss KRW 5,350,472,391 against KRW 7,151,558,288. On a separate (parent-only) basis Q2 revenue was KRW 124,764,004,376 against KRW 74,375,716,013 and operating profit KRW 3,819,319,374 against KRW 880,818,438 a year earlier.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 consolidated operating loss KRW 6,151,051,762 (Q2 2025 KRW 6,721,677,481); separate-basis Q2 OP KRW 3,819,319,374 (Q2 2025 KRW 880,818,438)

quarterly_data.signal: R&D items not covered earlier (amended half-year report). Completed: small-package technology (LGA, QFN packages) to strengthen the package line-up for new business; a flip-chip RF module package with RF characteristics optimised, now contributing to mass production and revenue; back-end process technology for bare-type (exposed chip) flip-chip products, now in mass production. Planned, self-funded: EMI shielding infrastructure and technology; laser ablation infrastructure for advanced SiP; wide-substrate infrastructure and technology; mass-production operating capability for high-thermal-performance bare / exposed-type flip-chip products; film-assist mould mass-production technology for exposed-chip packages.
